**Best move:** Qe5+

**Main line:** Qe5+ Qe7 Qxh8 h4

**Motif:** fork (the check forks the king and the undefended rook)

**Coaching note:**

When you give check, look at what pieces become loose or undefended during the forcing sequence. Here, Qe5+ checks the king and simultaneously attacks the undefended h8-rook. Black must respond to check with Qe7, leaving the rook undefended, so you simply capture it with Qxh8, winning the exchange and the game. Always scan the board after each forcing move—loose pieces are free pieces.
